title: Farmers Market Vendor Checklist
subtitle: Farmers Market Vendor Operation: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Farmers Market Vendor Checklist covers vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout. The market vendor coordinator records Farmers Market Vendor Operation criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Farmers Market Vendor Checklist keeps Farmers Market Vendor Operation exceptions visible until the market vendor coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Farmers Market Vendor Checklist at market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area. Document vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout identity before Farmers Market Vendor Operation begins. Compare vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout findings with stated Farmers Market Vendor Operation criteria; route unresolved Farmers Market Vendor Operation issues to market operations or food-safety reviewer. For Farmers Market Vendor Checklist, confirm requirements for Farmers Market Vendor Operation. Ask market operations or food-safety reviewer to review Farmers Market Vendor Operation conditions beyond the market vendor coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Farmers Market Vendor Operation, identify responsible parties, market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area, and the linked vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout source.

fields.label: Product, lot, source, quantity, and price
Permit, insurance, contact, and payment identifiers

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Farmers Market Vendor Operation facts for vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farmers Market Vendor Operation inspection checks
items: Label, price, allergen, and customer information
Cash, electronic payment, and sales reconciliation
Unsold product, waste, complaint, and incident closeout

columns.label: Approval, source, label, or temperature criterion
Accept, hold, exception, or not checked

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Before closing Farmers Market Vendor Operation, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Market Vendor Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Complaint or unsold product lacks disposition
blocks.guidance: Pause Farmers Market Vendor Operation when vendor authority, product trace, display control, complaint, or product disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Farmers Market Vendor Operation proof and route unresolved vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout scope to market vendor coordinator.
